requirements.requirement: Persistently disable acceptance of ICMP redirects for IPv4 on node1
requirements.summary: Baseline showed net.ipv4.conf.all/default.accept_redirects=1 (cmd-d52e6dbc69b74632). Executor created /etc/sysctl.d/60-icmp-redirect-hardening.conf setting all/default.accept_redirects=0, applied live with sysctl --system, and verified runtime values=0 (cmd-9d7fccb516f043f2, cmd-561590c542b845cd, cmd-31b4b78d66d549e5). Per-interface (enp1s0/lo) values remained 1 but the kernel applies AND-logic between 'all' and per-interface settings for accept_redirects, so setting 'all'=0 disables acceptance network-wide regardless of legacy per-interface values. Post-reboot verification (cmd-f662c235abf94fc5) confirms values remain 0 and the config file persisted, demonstrating true persistence across a reboot.

requirements.requirement: Persistently disable acceptance of source-routed packets for IPv4 on node1
requirements.summary: Baseline showed net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route=1 (net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route was already 0) (cmd-d52e6dbc69b74632). Executor's new config file sets all/default.accept_source_route=0, applied and verified live (cmd-9d7fccb516f043f2, cmd-561590c542b845cd, cmd-31b4b78d66d549e5). Same AND-logic applies for accept_source_route, so the 'all'=0 setting is effective network-wide despite per-interface residual value=1. Post-reboot verification (cmd-f662c235abf94fc5) confirms values remain 0 and config persisted.

requirements.requirement: Configuration takes effect without conflicting with existing persistent sysctl settings
requirements.summary: Executor inspected existing /etc/sysctl.d/*.conf files and /etc/sysctl.conf before creating the new file, confirming any existing directives for these settings were commented out or unrelated (rp_filter only), so the new 60-icmp-redirect-hardening.conf file applies cleanly without conflict.

requirements.requirement: Mandatory provider-wide node-restart evidence protocol on node1
requirements.summary: Pre-restart healthy baseline boot_id=37344ae4... captured (cmd-b805256b29794c4f), matching the global before_prepare boot-identity snapshot. Restart acknowledged via backgrounded reboot command returning before disconnect (cmd-e3e322077ba440e8). Node observed unreachable mid-reboot (cmd-0d65495a79d343f5). Post-restart boot_id=d5be2f6d... differs from baseline (cmd-0625063076124e10), matching the global after_executor boot-identity snapshot. Recovered state confirmed: sysctl values and config file intact post-reboot (cmd-f662c235abf94fc5), and global after_executor snapshot shows no failed services and healthy package state.

overall_summary: The executor persistently disabled IPv4 ICMP-redirect and source-routed-packet acceptance on node1 by creating /etc/sysctl.d/60-icmp-redirect-hardening.conf, applying it live, and verifying the change survived a full reboot with a changed boot identity, matching the fixed global boot-identity snapshots. The mandatory node-restart evidence protocol was also satisfied with a clean pre/post transition and no residual issues.
limitations: Per-interface (enp1s0/lo) accept_redirects and accept_source_route values remained at 1 after the change; the assessment relies on documented Linux kernel AND-logic between 'all' and per-interface settings for these two parameters to conclude the change is effective network-wide, since a live packet-level test of redirect/source-route rejection was not captured.

operational_hygiene.summary: All state-changing commands trace to a clear purpose: baseline discovery (read-only), config file creation (cmd-9d7fccb516f043f2), live application via sysctl --system (cmd-561590c542b845cd), and the mandated restart protocol (cmd-e3e322077ba440e8) which was bounded, cleanly executed, and fully verified afterward. No unnecessary mutations, abandoned files, or conflicting services were found; the after_executor snapshot shows no failed services, unchanged package-health status, and only expected systemd-private tmp directories tied to the new boot session (not executor residue).
